selection_basis: The new task retains the already grounded successful Oracle Walk4/Turn45/Stop template, with distinct mission and node IDs. Its post-halt starting state has not been validated for restart; this is one conditional feasibility case, not route recovery. Walk2 is excluded because the frozen capability map has no exact 2m grounding cell.

state_assessment.scope: Eligibility for this exact new local task at this observed simulation instant; no dwell, generic safe/recovered, or hardware stopping claim.

runs.adaptive_authorized: Original frozen failure with strict feedback and opt-in M2.1 halt; fresh assessment; missing and forged/mismatched grant probes with zero dispatch; matching study grant permits the new mission only if state and mission checks pass. Attempt replay after dispatch; zero further steps required.
runs.halt_only_no_authorization: Same original failure, strict feedback and halt, but no grant. Assess real final state and refuse new task with ESCALATE; no new task nodes or physics. This is the paired halt-only/static lifecycle control.
runs.normal_control: Original frozen normal mission, strict feedback and opt-in halt configured; no new task requested. Compare original 3/3 nodes, no halt and pose/result metrics to retained R1 control.

offline_controls: Retained real parent pre-halt state must fail task-scoped state assessment; explicitly a read-only recorded-state control, not a new live run.
Focused fixture tests for failed halt, nonfinite/not-standing/high-speed state, missing/forged/mismatched/stale/replayed grant, mission validation/grounding and parent evidence mutation.
stop_rule: Run each declared seed-0 case at most once. Retain all outcomes. An ineligible assessment or denied authorization executes zero new task nodes; no substitute or parameter tuning. A new task failure retains FAILED and may invoke only the already configured frozen M2.1 halt for a strict Walk failure, then escalates with no further mission. Stop remaining acquisition immediately on reset/continuity/source-integrity violation or acquisition exception; preserve partial evidence. No extra case, seed, retry, recovery search, training or model call.
interpretation: A successful new task would show only bounded same-session mission restart feasibility with experimental configuration authorization. It does not repair the original route, erase its strict failure, establish Human Principal Authority, unlock Language Runtime, or prove production/hardware safety.
